primary.title: Why large cap and mid cap funds could be the best mutual fund to bet on now, according to Abakkus study
primary.summary: Abakkus Mutual Fund's study highlights Large & Mid Cap Funds as an appealing investment option amid improving earnings and reasonable valuations. The market correction has created entry points for long-term investors, suggesting the potential for stock prices to align with earnings growth.
